rootCause.key: Default req.ip, IPv6 subnet normalization; not account or session
rootCause.store: Default per-limiter MemoryStore, in-process Maps; not PostgreSQL
rootCause.previousLifecycle: One Playwright invocation, one API process, all 23 tests serial with workers=1
rootCause.lastFailure: 30th auth attempt had remaining=0; next relogin returned 429

fix.execution: Two sequential Playwright invocations, each owns fresh API/Vite/Storage processes; reuseExistingServer=false; workers=1
fix.database: Same isolated loopback PostgreSQL allowed: limiter is not database-backed; no cloud DB
fix.coverage: Base excludes only recovery file; second includes exactly that file; no tests omitted across entrypoint
